Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
In pursuance of the earlier order dated 18.04.2023, Investigating Officer, Mr. Abhimanyu Mal,
Station Officer, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki
is present.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant inF.I.R. No. 988 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.

It is further submitted that there is no evidence against the applicant and he has been Satish Kumar Sharma @ Raju @ Satish ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Secy. Home ... on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116501770/
1 implicated only on the ground that he was associated within the co-accused, Dharmendra Singh.

entities.text: Satish Kumar Sharma @ Raju @ Satish ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the applicant is ready to cooperate in the investigation, therefore, he may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer of the applicant and submits that the applicant is not cooperating in the investigation and he is absconding from the first day.
It is further submitted that non-bailable warrant has already been issued by the competent court, on the request of the Investigating Officer.

Learned A.G.A., while relying on the decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of M.P. Vs. Pradeep Sharma (2014) 2 SCC 171 , submits that, in case, the accused person is not cooperating in the investigation and non-bailable warrant is issued by the competent court, the accused person is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of F.I.R., bail application as well as other relevant documents as also in view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of M.P. Vs. Pradeep Sharma (supra)
